data.summary:
Detail-oriented and dedicated AML/KYC Analyst with 15 months of experience in client onboarding. Cross-trained in the UK, Malaysia, and default regions, with hands-on experience onboarding clients globally (excluding EU and sanctioned countries). Well-versed in verifying various types of Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA) documents across multiple jurisdictions. Skilled in using Onfido, LexisNexis, SAMS (Solytics Partners), and WealthKernel for customer due diligence and
regulatory screening. Also responsible for resolving onboarding-related customer queries escalated via the support team. Certified in Investment Banking Operations from Imarticus Learning, with a B.Com degree, strong analytical and communication skills, and proficiency in Excel functions like VLOOKUP.
Experienced with transaction monitoring and identifying suspicious
activities. Utilizes data analysis and regulatory knowledge to ensure compliance and mitigate risks. Track record of enhancing anti-money
laundering measures and improving overall transaction security.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK HISTORY
Transaction Monitoring Analyst, 11/2025 to Current Teleperformance - Mumbai, India
Enhanced transaction monitoring system efficiency by streamlining
processes and implementing risk-based approaches.
Contributed to risk assessments by providing insights from transaction
monitoring activities, helping the organization stay ahead of potential threats.
Perform transaction monitoring and review of customer activity to identify
potentially suspicious transactions and risk indicators.
Analyze customer and transaction information using a risk-based approach and
escalate potentially suspicious activity in line with internal procedures.
Assisted in the development of new transaction monitoring rules based
on emerging trends and typologies.
Collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams to identify potential
risks and develop mitigation strategies.
AML/KYC Analyst, 04/2024 to 08/2025 Wahed Technology pvt Ltd. - Mumbai
Performed end-to-end KYC onboarding and periodic reviews for retail
and institutional clients.
Used tools such as Onfido, LexisNexis, SAMS (Solytics Partners), and
WealthKernel for identity verification, risk screening, and adverse media checks.
Assessed client documentation and ensured compliance with regulatory
requirements (AML, KYC, CDD).
• Verified and validated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) and supported
SSI call-back procedures to authenticate settlement details and mitigate
operational and settlement risks.
within defined timelines.
